newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecom, Portucel keep Portugal shares positive.
newsitem.headline: Telecom, Portucel keep Portugal shares positive.

text.p: Shares closed narrowly positive thanks to the continuing strength of Portugal Telecom and gains by pulp and paper producer Portucel Industrial.
*The outlook for the two stocks will depend on the performance of other bourses as foreign investors are the main motors for their price movements, traders said.
*Telecom was lifted by foreign interest to a new high of 5,700 escudos before closing just below the peak at 5,695 escudos.
*Banco Comercial Portugues was not expected to show any big reaction to news of a 14.8 percent rise in profit as this had been largely discounted by the market, traders and analysts said.
*Elsewhere, domestic investors could look to take some more profit after the sharp gains at the start of the year.
*"It is always healthy to have a correction after a sharp rise," commented one trader.
